name: Zim Laboratories Ltd
title: Zim Laboratories Ltd - 541400 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Zim is a sub-scale, EU-GMP-constrained pharma exporter: FY26 revenue flat at INR 3,744m, EBITDA INR 414m, with regulated revenue gated by an unresolved May 2026 re-inspection and no capacity-discipline signal.

capex.quote: We've already invested in a quite heavy CapEx cycle, and that is, almost near to completion.

triggers.label: MENA revenue impact ~INR 20 crore
triggers.quote: We estimate a revenue impact of approximately INR 20 crore that we could have otherwise achieved from this region
triggers.highlight: revenue impact of approximately INR 20 crore

triggers.label: No FY27 numeric guidance; H1 guidance deferred
triggers.quote: For the coming year, we have already explained you that the future guidance here, as of now, we are not giving.

triggers.label: Sildenafil supply stopped pending EU GMP
triggers.quote: Sildenafil, right now, the supplies have stopped because, obviously, we are in the remediation process.

triggers.label: EU GMP re-inspection outcome pending
triggers.quote: the draft inspection report is expected the next coming days

guidance.value: upper teens / mid-teens once regulated markets start
guidance.quote: we are projecting upper teens as our EBITDA margins once everything kind of starts going on in the regulated markets
we have projected about 10% to 15% growth happening every year

guidance.value: Flat borrowings and finance cost this year
guidance.quote: this year, perhaps the borrowing will remain constant and similarly the finance cost will also remain same

red_flags.label: EU GMP re-inspection outcome unconfirmed; CAPA and critical-observation status not disclosed
red_flags.quote: we deliberately did not give any observations because this closing meeting is usually an informal meeting

red_flags.label: Management declines to quantify FY27 guidance
red_flags.quote: you would want to avoid that. That would be a very future looking statement.

evasions.topic: NIP+OTF revenue share and FY27 quantum
evasions.quote: it's a bit difficult to know right now

evasions.topic: INR 250-300 crore peak potential over three years
evasions.quote: It could be this. It could be this. It could be a lot higher, a lot lower.
we deliberately did not give any observations
It is not fixed. It will be very marginal.
